design.scope: Add images to the existing inline scanner; preserve existing Wiki links, tables, lists, links and math rendering
design.safe_sources: http(s) and ordinary relative URLs, including balanced parentheses and percent-encoded Unicode/space/percent filenames
design.rejection: Forbidden schemes, protocol-relative authorities, raw/encoded controls and backslashes render readable alt text with no image node
design.attributes: Escaped src/alt, fixed max-width:100%;height:auto, lazy loading, async decoding and no-referrer
design.math: Image attributes restore readable formula delimiters. Final KaTeX replacement skips generated HTML tags, preventing placeholder-shaped input from injecting markup into attributes. Inline/fenced code stays literal.

verification.browser: Installed Playwright Chromium headless; controlled browser routes return actual PNG bytes and inspect real DOM/image decoding

initial_red.primary_failure: Standard image syntax produced 0 actual image nodes, expected 6

final_green.command: cd frontend && npm run test:unit -- utils/markdown-lite.images.test.mjs utils/markdown-lite.test.mjs utils/wiki-links.test.mjs

observed_browser_results: Six http/https/root/current-directory/parent-directory/plain-relative image sources each complete with naturalWidth=1 and naturalHeight=1
Balanced parentheses and query ampersands remain in the DOM src
No Referer header on controlled image requests
Twenty forbidden/obfuscated image URLs create zero image nodes and zero image requests while retaining readable alt
Quoted alt/src do not create event attributes, script nodes or injected markup
Math in image alt/src remains readable text; only adjacent real math produces a KaTeX node
Math containing literal placeholder-shaped text cannot reinsert KaTeX HTML into image attributes
Inline/fenced image syntax and formula delimiters remain literal; no image request occurs
Image nodes also render in headings, lists, tables and nested link labels
Leading/trailing raw controls and encoded tab create no image requests
Chinese, percent-encoded space, literal percent and UTF-8 relative filenames load with naturalWidth=1
verification.fixture_correction: Controlled HTML responses now explicitly declare UTF-8; initial intermediate assertions exposed fixture charset decoding, corrected only in the test fixture
verification.diff_check: git diff --check on the two owned source/test paths: exit 0
verification.unified_frontend_suite_and_build: Delegated to parser_baseline after source freeze; not claimed by this targeted evidence
